source.note: Shirt-sponsor table row. The article's prose also names Digi as a front-of-shirt sponsor: Digi is 'both a front-of-shirt sponsor (Rayo Vallecano and vertical on Racing Santander's shirtfronts) and a back-of-shirt sponsor (Athletic)'.

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.note: Sleeve-sponsor table row. GCS has been Rayo's sleeve sponsor since the club announcement of 15 September 2023 (rayovallecano.es/noticias/gcs-nuevo-patrocinado-del-rayo-vallecano): 'Este nuevo patrocinador tendrá presencia en la manga de la equipación de juego del primer equipo masculino, femenino y del filial.'

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.note: Kit-sponsor table row: Umbro makes the 2026/27 Rayo Vallecano shirt (kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention). 2Playbook reported on 18 September 2023: 'El club madrileño cuenta con Digi y Umbro como patrocinadores principales' and 'Digi y Umbro (socio técnico)'.

summary: Digi on the front, GCS on the sleeve, Umbro as kit maker. The article's back-of-shirt and shorts tables list no back or shorts sponsor for Rayo (Digi's back-of-shirt deal is with Athletic).
